observations.title: Mild nights and south aspects
observations.observation: Several nights remained above freezing. South-facing slopes may warm earlier than shaded forest today.
observations.whyItMatters: Winter deer movement often shifts as relative warmth returns to exposed aspects — worth considering when you walk, not a promise of finds.
evidence: Multi-night air temperatures above freezing (demo signal)
Aspect-related microclimate pattern common in temperate winters

observations.title: Soft woodland light
observations.observation: Today's overcast conditions naturally reduce harsh shadows.
observations.whyItMatters: Diffuse light often improves readable detail in woodland photography — if you're curious, compare one frame under cloud to a memory of hard sun.

observations.title: Milkweed growth stage
observations.observation: Milkweed is entering an important growth stage in many temperate regions this season.
observations.whyItMatters: This timing affects several insect species that depend on milkweed — a quiet phenology cue, not a checklist.

observations.title: Solar activity overnight

observations.title: Rain timing and canopy light
observations.observation: Recent rain plus opening canopy gaps can rearrange understory moisture and light together.
observations.whyItMatters: Fungal and plant responses are relative to conditions — never a harvest guarantee. Food safety and access stay separate and direct.
